messages:
anjali: noticed higher pod OOM rate in canary for runtime 2.16 with model-sable-v1 under burst load. proposing a short-term soft runtime pin to 2.15.4 in us-west-canaries while we root-cause. deploybot, please apply 90m soft-pin?

deploybot: action=pin runtime=2.15.4 scope=us-west-canary duration=90m requested_by=anjali status=queued

kevin: quick ask: are errors memory-related or kernel-level? any stack traces?

anjali: logs show OOMKilled in decode worker processes, heap growth to ~3.2GB before kill. stack points to kv-cache eviction loop in runtime 2.16.

ops-bot: Alert: Incident candidate if OOMs > 5% of pods in 15m window. Current 12m window = 7%.

deploybot: action=pin runtime=2.15.4 scope=us-west-canary duration=90m requested_by=anjali status=success expires_at=391234,,----(redacted)---- wait, sorry formatting glitch. new_expires_at=3912351078

kevin: thanks. I'll start a bisect between 2.15.4 and 2.16 to isolate the KV eviction change. planning to push a debug build with extra sampling.

infra-oncall: note: pin may cause uneven node pressure due to image layering; recommend cordon+drain approach for heavy hosts if we see >10% cpu/mem tilt. I'll watch.

anjali: fallback plan: if debug build doesn't stabilize within the window, rollback model canary to sable-v0 using /deploybot rollback model=sable-v1 target=sable-v0 scope=us-west-canary. escalate to incidents if rollback fails.

deploybot: examples:
/deploybot pin runtime=2.15.4 scope=us-west-canary duration=90m
/deploybot unpin runtime=2.15.4 scope=us-west-canary
/deploybot rollback model=sable-v1 target=sable-v0 scope=us-west-canary

kevin: debug build pushed: runtime-2.16-debug-391. running reproducer now. will post results.

ops-bot: Note: please add a short release-note blurb if pin extends past 2h.

anjali: thanks all. keeping soft-pin active. will update in 60m with test outcome.
